entry.name: mc.slide~
entry.description: Use the slide~ object for envelope following and lowpass filtering.

arguments.name: slide-up
arguments.description: Specifies the slide up value. The default is 1. (Also accepts integers for these arguments as well as the associated messages which address these parameter settings.)

arguments.name: slide-down
arguments.description: A second argument specifies the slide down value. The default is 1. (Also accepts integers for these arguments as well as the associated messages which address these parameter settings.)

messages.name: reset
messages.digest: Set the current output sample value to 0
messages.description: Sets the current output sample value to 0 (the next incoming value will smoothly transition from that 0).

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: A signal to be filtered. Whenever a new value is received,filters the input signal logarithmically between changes in signal value using the formula:y (n) = y (n-1) + ((x (n) - y (n-1))/slide)A given sample output fromis equal to the last sample's value plus the difference between the last sample's value and the input divided by the slide value. Given a slide value of 1, the output will therefore always equal the input. Given a slide value of 10, the output will only change 1/10th as quickly as the input. This can be particularly useful for lowpass filtering or envelope following.In middle inlet: Use a signal to set the slide-up value.In right inlet: Use a signal to set the slide-down value.
